title: A Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of ITI-1284 in the Treatment of Agitation Associated With Alzheimer's Dementia
official: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Flexible-dose Study of the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of ITI-1284 in Patients With Agitation Associated With Alzheimer's Dementia
summary: This is a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, flexible-dose study of the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of ITI-1284 in patients with agitation associated with Alzheimer's dementia.

sites.f: Premiere Research Institute at Palm Beach Neurology
